answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks via geospatial laser ranging attestation. Each node pulses coherent light toward a reference mirror mounted in an alignment quill atop a surveyed knoll, measuring precise optical transit times. Attackers cannot spoof these propagation delays remotely and must deploy discrete optical transceivers at distinct geographic coordinates per identity. However, atmospheric scintillation and dense fog cause beam wander, creating false rejections.
